intro: 117 real HSK 1–6 papers, taken on screen like the exam room: original paper pages, original recordings, timed sections and HSK scoring.
load_error: Couldn't load the paper. Please reload the page.

mode_desc.strict: Like the real exam: the listening recording plays once without pausing, then you get a few minutes to finish your answers. Reading and Writing are timed separately and move on when time is up. You can't go back to a finished section.
mode_desc.practice: No time limit, move freely between questions, pause and rewind the recording, see the transcript when the paper has one.

ime_note: Writing needs Chinese characters: turn on your device's Chinese (pinyin) keyboard.

rules.listening: The recording plays straight through once and can't be paused. Answer while you listen; afterwards you have {{minutes}} minutes to finish.
rules.reading: Answer in any order within this section. When time runs out you move to the next section.
rules.writing: Type your answers in Chinese characters. When time runs out the paper is submitted.

confirm_section: You can't come back to this section afterwards.
audio_failed: The recording for this paper can't be played.
press_play: Press play to listen; rewind as often as you like.
order_hint: Tap A, B and C in the right order.
type_here: Type your answer in Chinese characters
pass_rule: HSK {{level}} is passed with {{pass}}/{{max}} or more. Each skill is scored out of 100.
check_writing: {{count}} written answers differ from the sample or are free writing; they count as wrong until you grade them.
setup_desc: Official HSK {{level}} paper, questions cut from the original pages.
no_audio: This paper has no recording, so listening can only be guessed.
tape_playing: The recording is playing. Answer as you listen.
tape_done: Recording finished. Complete your answers before time runs out.
audio_blocked: The browser hasn't allowed sound yet. Press Listen to start.

kind.abcd: Choose A, B, C or D
kind.ae: Choose sentence A–E for the blank
kind.order: Put A, B, C in order

in_block: Question {{n}} is in the part of the paper above.
sub_hint: Question {{n}} is ★ question {{i}} of {{k}} in this passage.
no_sample: Free writing with no sample answer. Grade it yourself.
tape_review: Listen to the paper's recording again
